sections.title: How we keep ML projects on budget and on target

blocks.heading: Data problems surface in Discovery, not mid-project
paragraphs: The most common reason ML projects run over budget is data problems discovered after work starts — missing labels, inaccessible systems, poor data quality or schema changes. We run a paid Discovery phase first, so data readiness is assessed before you commit to the full build.

blocks.heading: Performance targets are contractual
paragraphs: Target metrics are defined in the contract during Discovery. We iterate until the agreed targets are met — you are not paying for failed iterations.

blocks.heading: Custom ML or fine-tuning?
paragraphs: Custom ML model development involves feature engineering and architecture choices for structured or domain data. Fine-tuning adapts an existing foundation model to your domain. We recommend whichever fits the problem.

sections.title: Questions about machine learning model development

items.question: What does machine learning model development cost?
items.answer: $25,000–$200,000 depending on problem type, data availability and compliance requirements. Most enterprise ML projects fall between $40,000 and $100,000.

items.question: How long does ML model development take?
items.answer: 8–32 weeks. Simple classification on existing data typically takes 8–12 weeks; enterprise fraud ML with sub-100ms real-time scoring takes 18–28 weeks.

items.question: Do you deliver production systems or research models?
items.answer: Production ML systems — including data pipeline, API serving, monitoring and MLOps infrastructure. We do not hand over notebooks; we deliver systems that run reliably in your infrastructure.

items.question: Can you build on our existing cloud?
items.answer: Yes. We build on your existing AWS, Azure or Google Cloud infrastructure. No platform partnership influences model selection.

items.question: What happens if the model doesn't meet performance targets?
items.answer: Performance targets are defined in the contract during Discovery. We work iteratively until the agreed targets are met — you are not paying for failed iterations.

items.question: Do you offer fixed-price ML development?
items.answer: Yes. After Discovery you receive a fixed-price proposal covering data readiness, model architecture and total project cost.
